title: It opens as the community grows.
description: We’re not opening everything at once. Today it’s streams and clips; new features unlock on their own as membership grows.

items.name: Streams, clips and the Koina app
items.text: We code live every Saturday at 20:00 and share the most useful moments as short clips. Create an account to follow the calendar and posts.

items.name: Useful links
items.text: Members share the tools and resources they find; the most useful rise to the top.

items.name: Feed
items.text: Posts, replies, bookmarks and notifications: the community talks among itself.

items.name: Following
items.text: Follow members and shape your own feed.

items.name: Projects and a first team
items.text: Project pages open. The first project starts once a mentor and a small team are ready.

items.name: Seasons
items.text: If the first project works: regular seasons with more projects and teams.

items.name: Mobile app
items.text: Once the community is here every day, the app comes to your pocket too.

note: Goals, not dates: when a goal is reached the feature opens, and people who opted in to news hear first.
